top_signals.title: European Stocks Advance on Falling Oil Prices; ASML Drops
top_signals.summary: European stocks gained as oil prices retreated on signs of easing tensions in the Middle East. ASML Holding NV fell 5.0% after a report that a Chinese state-backed company had begun manufacturing immersion deep ultraviolet lithography machines.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: China industrial profit growth slows again in June as retreating oil prices sap earnings lift
top_signals.summary: Corporate earnings have staged one of the strongest turnarounds in the economy this year, swinging from barely positive growth in 2025 to double-digit gains.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Commodity repricing impacting inflation expectations and industrial supply chains.

top_signals.title: Chipmaker CXMT’s 466% market debut surge makes it the most valuable China-listed company
top_signals.summary: The Hefei-based company raised 57.92 billion yuan ($8.6 billion) after pricing its IPO at 8.66 yuan per share.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Citi Traders Are Betting Fed Will Keep Rates on Hold This Week
top_signals.summary: Citigroup Inc.’s traders are betting the Federal Reserve will leave rates unchanged this week, even as the swap markets assign a more than one-in-three chance of a quarter-point hike.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.
